name: Manus AI n8n Automation Pack 🤖 🫰🏽
description_md:
## What You Get

- 
3 comprehensive sets of n8n workflow automations (10 automations per set), fully created by the autonomous Manus AI system.

- 
JSON implementation files, ready for instant import to n8n, including client onboarding, milestone recognition, session scheduling, social media automation, and content engagement workflows.

- 
Detailed workflow documentation, clearly explaining the functionality and integration process for every automation.

- 
Original prompts used to generate each batch of workflows—allowing you to replicate or customize additional automations effortlessly.

- 
Massive time savings and reduced costs compared to manually creating or purchasing workflow templates, making automation accessible even with no coding experience.
